description: This file contains functions and types for managing user profiles in a Matrix client, including avatar URL handling, profile synchronization, and media uploading.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalText
methods.description: Trims and normalizes optional string input, returning null if input is not a string or is empty.

methods.name: isMatrixMxcUri
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid mxc:// URI.

methods.name: isMatrixHttpAvatarUri
methods.description: Checks if a string is an http or https URL.

methods.name: isSupportedMatrixAvatarSource
methods.description: Determines if a string is a supported avatar source (mxc:// or http(s) URL).

methods.name: uploadAvatarMedia
methods.description: Uploads avatar media content using provided load function and returns the uploaded URL.

methods.name: resolveAvatarUrl
methods.description: Resolves the avatar URL, handling local paths, mxc URIs, and http URLs, possibly uploading media.

methods.name: syncMatrixOwnProfile
methods.description: Synchronizes the user's display name and avatar URL with the Matrix server, updating only if necessary.
